notes: Item evidence.provenance is null for all three trigger paths; verified directly from the task snapshots. The permission token 'Ros_Controller_IsRemote(controller)' is a function call (not a permission name) that the consumer uses as a gate checking IOSTATUS_REMOTE (remote mode). Neither unit grants remote mode (it is a hardware I/O state, not a software grant), so both grant sets are genuinely absent. The spec classifies this case's failed condition as 'other' (wrong robot_id/sequence values), not permission_missing; this finding reflects a permission-requirement the method extracted from the consumer's remote-mode gate.
